user.title: DNS Manager
user.description: Create an instance. Providers and managed records are configured afterwards from the integration Options.

general.title: General settings
general.description: Polling and synchronisation settings for this instance.

data.auto_sync: Automatically update DNS when out of sync

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check status (default 300 s).
data_description.ip_detection_url: Used by records with Auto IPv4 strategy.
data_description.ipv6_detection_url: Leave empty to disable Auto IPv6. Example: https://api6.ipify.org?format=json
data_description.auto_sync: When enabled, each poll writes DNS for out-of-sync records.

providers_menu.title: Providers
providers_menu.description: Saved providers: {providers_count}. A provider stores credentials once; records are attached to it.

records_menu.title: Managed records
records_menu.description: Managed records: {records_count}. Each record uses a saved provider and its own IP strategy.

add_provider_type.title: Add provider — Type
add_provider_type.description: Step 1: choose the provider type. If a provider for the same zone or hostname already exists, its credentials are updated instead of creating a duplicate.

add_provider_cloudflare_credentials.title: Add provider — Cloudflare credentials
add_provider_cloudflare_credentials.description: Step 2 of 3: authenticate with Cloudflare. An API Token with Zone:Read and DNS:Edit is recommended.

add_provider_cloudflare_zone.title: Add provider — Cloudflare zone
add_provider_cloudflare_zone.description: Step 3 of 3: choose the zone this provider will manage ({zones_count} available).

add_provider_duckdns.title: Add provider — DuckDNS
add_provider_duckdns.description: Step 2 of 2: account token (shared by all subdomains). Optionally enter one subdomain to verify the token now.

data_description.subdomain: Without .duckdns.org. Used only to validate the token; subdomains are chosen when adding records.

add_provider_hostname_auth.title: Add provider — {provider}
add_provider_hostname_auth.description: Step 2 of 2: {provider} account for a single hostname.

add_provider_dynv6.title: Add provider — dynv6
add_provider_dynv6.description: Step 2 of 2: dynv6 zone and HTTP token.

remove_provider_select.title: Remove provider
remove_provider_select.description: Saved providers: {providers_count}. A provider still used by a record cannot be removed.

add_record_select_provider.title: Add record — Provider
add_record_select_provider.description: Step 1: choose a saved provider ({providers_count} available). Credentials are reused.

add_record_cloudflare_select.title: Add record — DNS record
add_record_cloudflare_select.description: Step 2: choose the record to manage on {provider}.

add_record_duckdns_subdomain.title: Add record — DuckDNS subdomain
add_record_duckdns_subdomain.description: Step 2: subdomain for {provider}. The managed hostname will be subdomain.duckdns.org.

data_description.ip_mode: Auto uses the instance public IPv4; From URL / Static as configured. Off skips IPv4.
data_description.ipv6_mode: Requires a public IPv6 URL in General settings for Auto. Off skips IPv6.

data_description.ip_url: Plain text or JSON with an ip field.
data_description.ipv6_url: Plain text or JSON with an ip field.

edit_record_select.title: Edit record
edit_record_select.description: Managed records: {records_count}. Choose the record to edit.

data_description.ip_mode: Auto uses the instance public IPv4; From URL / Static as configured. Off skips IPv4.
data_description.ipv6_mode: Requires a public IPv6 URL in General settings for Auto. Off skips IPv6.
data_description.enabled: Disabled records are monitored but never updated.

data_description.ip_url: Plain text or JSON with an ip field.
data_description.ipv6_url: Plain text or JSON with an ip field.

remove_record_select.title: Remove record
remove_record_select.description: Managed records: {records_count}. The DNS record itself is not deleted at the provider.

abort.no_managed_records: No managed records yet. Add one from Options → Managed records → Add record.
abort.no_providers: No providers yet. Add one from Options → Providers → Add provider.
abort.provider_in_use: Cannot remove: one or more records still use this provider.
